purpose: Discovery: schedule-by-axis interaction with two fixed observation sites; not a new held-out evaluation.
other_graphs_role: Mechanism controls and exploratory analyses; do not pool them into the primary contrast.
comparison_contract: S and J must match within each request; global and row requests differ and are experimental factors, not interchangeable outputs.
primary_contrast_us: Within each session: median_process(mean_seed((m_row_J - m_row_S) - (m_count_J - m_count_S))), where m is the median of timed rounds for one process, input seed, and variant.
input_pairing: All four observed variants use the same seed in a randomized block. Three input-specific interactions receive equal weights within each process; keep each seed effect in raw summaries. Sham controls use identical aggregation.
calibration: Sham A/A in the same randomized block context as A/B; freeze the estimator and floor rule before confirmation. Alias pairs are dependent.
execution_note: This file specifies the first experiment. No new collector or performance result is claimed by this manifest. Implement collection only after confirming target runtime and dump capabilities.
